raw_text:
PLAN "Postpartum Return Programme (12 Weeks)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "gradual postpartum recovery and foundational strength"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Weeks 1-4 (Light activity only; protect incision; no abs; walking focus)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 20m "Gentle Mobility + Walking":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          marching 3x8..10 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          arm_circles 3x10..12 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          leg_swings 3x8..10 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          hip_circles 2x8..10 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          ankle_circles 2x10..12 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 20m "Gentle Mobility + Walking":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          marching 3x10..12 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          arm_circles 3x12..15 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          leg_swings 3x10..12 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          hip_circles 3x8..10 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          ankle_circles 2x12..15 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 20m "Gentle Mobility + Walking":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          marching 3x12..15 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          arm_circles 3x12..15 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          leg_swings 3x10..12 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          hip_circles 3x10..12 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          ankle_circles 2x12..15 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 25m "Walking + Gentle Lower Body Activation":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          box_step 3x6..8 rpe 3 rest 75 seconds
          glute_bridge 2x8..10 rpe 3 rest 75 seconds
          calf_raise 2x10..12 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          shoulder_stretch 2x20..30 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 20m "Mobility + Upper Body Range":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          arm_circles 3x12..15 rpe 2 rest 45 seconds
          shoulder_stretch 2x20..30 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          chest_stretch 2x20..30 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          back_stretch 2x20..30 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 25m "Walking + Gentle Lower Body Activation":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          box_step 3x8..10 rpe 3 rest 75 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x8..10 rpe 3 rest 75 seconds
          calf_raise 2x12..15 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          hip_flexor_stretch 2x20..30 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 25m "Walking + Controlled Patterns":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          step_up 3x6..8 rpe 3 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x10..12 rpe 3 rest 75 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 2x12..15 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 20m "Mobility Reset":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          hip_circles 3x10..12 rpe 2 rest 45 seconds
          figure_four_stretch 2x20..30 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          hamstring_stretch 2x20..30 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          chest_stretch 2x20..30 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 25m "Walking + Controlled Patterns":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          step_up 3x8..10 rpe 3 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x10..12 rpe 3 rest 75 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 25m "Walking + Gentle Total Body":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          step_up 3x8..10 rpe 3 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12..15 rpe 3 rest 75 seconds
          shoulder_stretch 2x20..30 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          chest_stretch 2x20..30 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 20m "Mobility + Posture":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          arm_circles 3x15..20 rpe 2 rest 45 seconds
          back_stretch 2x20..30 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          lat_stretch 2x20..30 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          hip_flexor_stretch 2x20..30 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 25m "Walking + Gentle Total Body":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          step_up 3x10..12 rpe 3 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12..15 rpe 3 rest 75 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
  PHASE "Phase 2: Weeks 5-8 (Progressive bodyweight; still light; avoid strain)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Walking + Lower Body Foundation":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8..10 rpe 4 rest 90 seconds
          step_up 3x8..10 rpe 4 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12..15 rpe 4 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 25m "Upper Body Mobility + Light Push/Pull":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          wall_ball 2x8..10 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 2x8..10 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          shoulder_stretch 2x20..30 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          chest_stretch 2x20..30 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 30m "Walking + Lower Body Foundation":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10..12 rpe 4 rest 90 seconds
          step_up 3x10..12 rpe 4 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12..15 rpe 4 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Walking + Total Body Control":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat 3x8..10 rpe 4 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..10 rpe 4 rest 75 seconds
          shoulder_press 2x8..10 rpe 4 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 25m "Mobility Reset + Calves/Glutes":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          standing_calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12..15 rpe 3 rest 75 seconds
          hamstring_stretch 2x20..30 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          hip_flexor_stretch 2x20..30 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 30m "Walking + Total Body Control":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat 3x10..12 rpe 4 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10..12 rpe 4 rest 75 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..10 rpe 4 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Walking + Posterior Chain":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          romanian_deadlift 3x8..10 rpe 4 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12..15 rpe 4 rest 75 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 25m "Upper Body Basics":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_row 3x10..12 rpe 4 rest 75 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..10 rpe 4 rest 75 seconds
          chest_stretch 2x20..30 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          back_stretch 2x20..30 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 30m "Walking + Lower Body Mix":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10..12 rpe 4 rest 90 seconds
          split_squat 3x8..10 rpe 4 rest 90 seconds
          step_up 2x10..12 rpe 4 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Walking + Balanced Strength":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          romanian_deadlift 3x10..12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x10..12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12..15 rpe 4 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 25m "Upper Body + Mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_row 3x10..12 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x10..12 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
          shoulder_stretch 2x20..30 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          lat_stretch 2x20..30 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 30m "Walking + Balanced Strength":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat 3x10..12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          step_up 3x10..12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
  PHASE "Phase 3: Weeks 9-12 (Build capacity; introduce gentle core if cleared)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 35m "Strength Endurance Lower":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 4x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          step_up 3x10..12 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Strength Endurance Upper":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_row 4x8..10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          face_pull 2x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 35m "Strength Endurance Mixed":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          step_up 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 3x15..20 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 35m "Lower Progression":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 4x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 4x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x15..20 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Upper Progression":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_row 4x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          shoulder_press 4x8..10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 35m "Mixed Lower Focus":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat 4x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          step_up 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 3x15..20 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 35m "Lower + Posterior Chain":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          romanian_deadlift 4x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          step_up 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Upper + Posture":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_row 4x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          shoulder_press 4x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 35m "Mixed Strength Endurance":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat 4x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          step_up 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 4x15..20 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday training 35m "Lower Volume Peak":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 4x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 4x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x15..20 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Upper Volume Peak":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_row 4x10..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          shoulder_press 4x10..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 35m "Mixed Volume Peak":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat 4x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          step_up 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 4x15..20 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
